this comment for the release after. -->

## New

- **Murmur tells you above the pill when an update is available.** macOS and Windows can hide notifications, which left the menu item as the only sign. Now a note above the pill says a new version is out and stays until your next dictation. Right-click the pill to update.

## Fixed

- **Choosing Update in the menu now says it's updating.** Before, nothing happened on screen until Murmur restarted.
